scope: Authorize 12 fresh Docs attempts. The remaining36 are conditional on both predeclared Docs gates. No target is claimed achieved.

delivery_review.scope: The same top-level setting reaches both arms and is stored in config, request settings and batch environment. Invalid modes and any per-arm override reject before provider execution. File mode preserves the exact copied skill/reference trees, omits the inline skill body, and instructs a complete ./guidance/SKILL.md read inside the measured tool loop.
delivery_review.default_compatibility: Default and explicit inline retain the prior prompt bytes. Accounting and verifier behavior are unchanged.
delivery_review.read_requirement: Complete reading is a shared prompt requirement, not an added independent-verifier success condition; actual model behavior remains part of the measured trial.
delivery_review.limits: Delivery and candidate entry length both change relative to07. No causal estimate of either factor alone and no attribution of specific historical read loops or billed costs.

candidate_guide_review.result: Shorter entry preserves direct routes, deeper original commands/references, rich-content fallbacks, native identity/marks/links, unknown-mutation reconciliation, success receipts and authorization requirements. No original function removed.
candidate_guide_review.fresh_checks: Embedded guide, nextskill and root tests passed; skill format passed with optional metadata warning; metadata/quality gate completed successfully.

runtime_validation_reuse.scope: Unchanged Go runtime only. Entry and candidate binary are newly built; this does not claim exact binary equality with06.
runtime_validation_reuse.private_native_lifecycle: Existing evidence remains applicable to unchanged native mutation semantics; no new native API operation or fidelity algorithm.

provider_availability.basis: All12 immediately preceding condition07 Docs attempts completed with known usage. No additional paid health probe for08.
provider_availability.limitation: Recent availability only; future success or complete accounting is not guaranteed.

conditional_design.docs_gate: For each task: three trials per arm, complete usage, no inconclusive outcomes, both success counts positive, Next successes >= original successes, and 2 * Next_tokens * original_successes < original_tokens * Next_successes. All attempt tokens count; exactly50 percent fails.
conditional_design.other_functions: At least30 percent reduction with observed success nonregression.
conditional_design.stop_rule: Retain all12 and report remaining36 not run if either Docs gate fails or is unavailable. No replacement, old baseline substitution or condition pooling.
conditional_design.limitations: Conditional development experiment with three repetitions and mutable provider alias; no stable population savings, statistical parity or full functionality coverage claim.

review_execution: Independent source, hash and retained-log inspection only. No tests or provider calls rerun by reviewer.
